description:
Substack Intel API — Posts, Archives & Publication Stats

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Run started: $0.00005; Post or publication row: $0.001; platform usage billed to your account.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/substack-intel-api.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

maxItems.description: Max posts to return in archive mode (0 = uncapped, safely limited to 5000).
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to fetch: archive (recent posts list), post (full post by slug), publication (publication profile + stats).
mode.title: Mode

publication.description: Substack slug (e.g. 'a16z') or custom domain (e.g. 'stratechery.com'). For custom domains, the substack slug is preferred when known.
publication.title: Publication

name: substack
